scientific_integrity: The classification of the linear span and the quaternion-only image theorem are credited to prior literature; the new claim is the exact octonion image and fixed-slice surjectivity in the quaternion-contained class. Computations check finite examples and are not used as a universal proof.
scientific_limitations: The image equality is proved for orthogonal independent isotropic coefficients co-contained in a nondegenerate quaternion composition subalgebra, over fields of characteristic not two. It does not cover all pairs in the unresolved general six-dimensional span case, nor characteristic two.
title: A six-dimensional image theorem for quaternion-contained generalized octonion commutators
